name: HCT116 p53-/-
cancer_subtype: Colorectal adenocarcinoma, isogenic TP53 knockout derivative of HCT116

signature_scores.raw_deg_evidence_ref: Maddocks et al. 2012 (PMID 23242140); p53-/- response per Figs. 1a-c and 3 (PMC6485472 full text)
signature_scores.notes: p53-/- HCT116 cells fail the serine-starvation metabolic remodelling response: no protective p53-p21 arrest, oxidative stress, reduced viability and severely impaired proliferation; serine/glycine-depleted diet also significantly reduced p53-/- xenograft volume in vivo (translates to p53-deficient tumour vulnerability).
signature_scores.modifier_agent: Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo)

interactions.curator_notes: Mechanism-only entry: p53-/- HCT116 cells fail the serine-starvation p53-p21/glutathione response and accumulate oxidative stress with reduced viability (Maddocks et al. 2012); doxorubicin imposes redox/nuclear stress, but the combination was not empirically tested in the source study. Awaiting a combination viability readout before any higher tier.
interactions.modifier_agent: Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo)

interactions.curator_notes: [Mechanistic Bridging -- model-generated hypothesis, not a tested result] Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (death_promoting) in HCT116 p53-/-; Metformin's reported resistance mechanism runs through the same pathway (SLC7A11/xCT cystine-glutamate antiporter). Because the modifier's effect on this pathway is death-promoting (suppresses the pathway the drug's resistance depends on), this is surfaced as a synergy candidate. This combination has not been evaluated together in any cited study -- it is a candidate for testing, generated by matching independently-curated signature and resistance-mechanism evidence, not a direct or inferred empirical finding.
interactions.modifier_agent: Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo)

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: High SLC7A11/xCT expression sustains cystine import and glutathione synthesis, protecting against metformin-induced ferroptosis; metformin acts in part by destabilizing SLC7A11 via UFMylation inhibition (Yang et al. 2021, [S8] above).

interactions.curator_notes: [Mechanistic Bridging -- model-generated hypothesis, not a tested result] Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (death_promoting) in HCT116 p53-/-; Erastin's reported resistance mechanism runs through the same pathway (GPX4-dependent lipid-peroxide detoxification). Because the modifier's effect on this pathway is death-promoting (suppresses the pathway the drug's resistance depends on), this is surfaced as a synergy candidate. This combination has not been evaluated together in any cited study -- it is a candidate for testing, generated by matching independently-curated signature and resistance-mechanism evidence, not a direct or inferred empirical finding.
interactions.modifier_agent: Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo)

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: GPX4 detoxifies lipid peroxides downstream of cystine/glutathione depletion; sufficient GPX4 activity (or an intact glutathione pool feeding it) can rescue cells from erastin's system Xc- blockade despite cystine starvation (Dixon et al. 2012; Yang et al. 2014).
